boundary_formula.state: Proved as an explicit application and check of Rains gluing; not a new general reconstruction theory.
boundary_formula.statement: For (rank,c1,chi(e,-))=(u,D,c), det F_q(x)=rho(D) q^(c-u). If q=P_a, boundary antiserre is t_a* (- tensor rho(H)); its value at O_E is rho(H) q^d.
boundary_formula.convention: t_a(x)=x+a. Pullback of degree k tensors by P_a^(-k), pushforward by P_a^k.

actual_dictionary.state: Conditional reconstruction from actual ordered boundary objects and a composition-preserving forward-RHom quasi-isomorphism.
actual_dictionary.statement: q=U2 U1^(-2), L=U1 U2^(-1); this identifies pointed directed dg models when the reconstructed geometric gluing exists. No t-exactness assertion.

literal_normalization_obstruction.state: Exact algebraic obstruction under a deliberately explicit common-boundary reading.
literal_normalization_obstruction.input: AOU v1 (9.2),(9.3),(9.25),(9.47) with the same E, point labels, sigma, and restriction identification.
literal_normalization_obstruction.conclusion: The printed restriction and printed boundary shift require Q^2=Q^3=O, Q=L1/L0=P_(-3b), so they cannot both hold in this common reading for infinite-order sigma=t_b.
literal_normalization_obstruction.not_concluded: Which source formula/convention needs correction, or that the source main theorem is false. No unverified replacement formula is used as an original theorem.

boundary_first_candidates.state: Necessary consistent candidates and conditional sufficiency if the corresponding geometric gluing exists.
boundary_first_candidates.statement: For actual boundary t_a*(- tensor N), q=P_a and L^3=N(sum points); L lies in a nine-element E[3] torsor. Keeping the printed shift gives q=L0/L1, L=L1 epsilon, U1=L0^-1 epsilon^-1, U2=(L0 L1)^-1 epsilon^-2.
